look_here_first: Check the leaves first: willow oak has long, narrow, unlobed willow-like blades with smooth margins and a tiny terminal bristle. Then check the small acorns in shallow saucer-like cups.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: narrow linear-lanceolate unlobed leaves, willow-like in outline

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: entire margins with a minute bristle at the leaf tip

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small acorns held in shallow saucer-shaped cups; mature in two seasons
